title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us — Episode6 As A Professional

meta.Event Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Shii!
Welcome! How can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, there's something I want to discuss with... Hey, hold up, personal space. I'm trying to talk here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I'm just so happy about you coming to see me like this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, it's not anything major...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
What's that in your hand, Shizuku?
Moon Viewing Stream...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, this?
It's about what we'll be doing for our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, exactly! We even decided to go with one of my ideas. Would you like to see?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's everything from what you need to prepare beforehand to how things will go the day of...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, sometimes we'll lose track of what we originally planned, so it's important to have an agenda prepared prior to it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I say we, but Airi always knows what to do. I'm usually the one who ends up stumbling around...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: O-Oh, I suppose that's just who I am...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But I still think this is really cool...
You came up with all this by yourself, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because the others are always coming up with such wonderful ideas...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still not sure how this one will go, but my goal is to do everything I can for them and our viewers.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Iori told me that having fun or just liking music won't be enough when we go pro.

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: She said that we'd have to put our music and fans first above anything else. She said that we'd be responsible for how they feel.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: This responsibility she's talking about may be about playing your best whenever you're on stage. At least, that's what I think...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It doesn't matter if you don't feel well or become sick, your audience will be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Shizuku's trying her best to make her dreams come true, just like me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She's not exactly pursuing her dreams. Rather, she's fulfilling her duties as a professional idol.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She understands how her fans feel about her and wants to put on the best performances she can for them... Like a true pro.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You really are an amazing person...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can see that you're doing your best, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Y-You've never said anything like this, Shii...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
H-Hey, calm down.
And why are you latching onto me?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can keep trying even harder since I know that you're there for me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay, I get it...
Just relax, will you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even when we were little, she was always there for me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And not just back then either. Maybe even...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii, wasn't there something you wanted to ask me...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I don't want to get in the way of whatever she and her group are doing either...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, don't you need to keep working on your stream?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's true too. As much as I'd like to keep spending quality time with you, I should wrap this up as soon as I can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I have to keep trying even harder since Shii's given me her support.
